title.zh: 【Blockaid：检测到 zkLink 跨链桥遭受攻击，目前已损失 78.6 万美元】
title.en: 【Blockaid：检测到 zkLink 跨链桥遭受攻击，目前已损失 78.6 万美元】

current_state.zh: Blockaid detected an ongoing exploit on the zkLink cross-chain bridge on Ethereum, where an attacker used a public relayer to inject a forged batch root and withdraw roughly $786K in ETH and ERC20 tokens from the zkLink Nova L1 custody contract.
current_state.en: Blockaid detected an ongoing exploit on the zkLink cross-chain bridge on Ethereum, where an attacker used a public relayer to inject a forged batch root and withdraw roughly $786K in ETH and ERC20 tokens from the zkLink Nova L1 custody contract.
